ideas.title: Following the Money in the Minnesota Child Care Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: This story would investigate the flow of funds in the Minnesota child care fraud scandal, including how the alleged scammers obtained and laundered the money.
questions: How did the alleged scammers obtain the child care funds?
How did they launder the money?
searches: Minnesota child care fraud financial investigation
ideas.insight: This story would require a deep dive into financial records and transactions to uncover the full scope of the scandal and identify potential accomplices or enablers.
